_comment: Grade 3 Unit 5 (You are welcome!) covers Personal contribution and Collaboration but not Making connections (3Ac, 'Talk about simple causes of personal actions and consequences on others') — a natural fit for its Amara/Imani inclusion story. Added 2026-09-17 to close a documented Stage 3 coverage gap.

addExplainers.title: How my actions make Imani feel
addExplainers.body:
When Amara walked over and said hello to Imani, and asked her to sit together, Imani felt welcome and happy. That did not happen by luck — Amara's action CAUSED it.

Now imagine the opposite: if nobody had spoken to Imani on her first morning, how would she have felt instead? A different action would have caused a different feeling.

Think of your own example: something YOU could do or say, and how it would make someone else feel. Draw or write your action, and draw or write how it would make them feel.
bullets: Think of an action you could take towards someone new.
Say what that action would cause them to feel.
Say what the opposite action would cause instead.

addObjectives.evidence: the Activity Sheet's new 'How my actions make Imani feel' page: "Amara's action CAUSED it ... a different action would have caused a different feeling" — talks about simple causes of personal actions and consequences on others
